jobs.description: Company: Marsh Description: We are seeking a talented individual to join our Technology Global Controls team at Marsh. This role will be based in Cluj-Napoca, Romania. You will be responsible for the preparation of Agency mortgage loan journal entries corresponding to the life cycle of the loan (i.e., borrower deposit, rate lock, funding, and loan settlement) as well as maintaining the associated cash logs. Our organization follows a hybrid work structure where employees work remotely and from the office. You are expected to be in the Dallas office three times a week. What you can expect Management of experienced accountants including preparation and supervision of the following: Agency cash logs and corresponding journal entries. Bank account reconciliations and management of the bank reconciliation database. Prepare or review closing wires and reconcile borrower’s deposits through loan fee accounting. Manage borrower directed reserve investments and ability to communicate with the borrower and investment advisor as needed. Mortgage loan accounting entries (including review and oversight of maintaining the Agency Mortgage Loan Master Files which track loans at rate lock, funding, and settlement). Review mortgage loan agreements to ensure use of correct interest rate and principal when preparing journal entries. Review monthly revenue schedules, financial reports and obtaining a solid understanding of the business to perform effective analytics (e.g., Revenue Schedules and Goal Posts). Review balance sheet reconciliations, and identify and institute account reconciliation efficiencies where warranted, in support of proper PASS account sign-off. Review quarterly journal entries and calculations (including CECL Reserves, FIN45 Reserves). Review quarterly reports in support of Agency mortgage loan information submitted to Corporate Accounting. Review accounting documentation in support of internal and external audits. Assist with the opening of new bank accounts and developing relationships with our banking partners. Prepare various analytical reports and support special projects on an as needed / Ad Hoc basis. Willingness to work extended hours during peak reporting periods and the ability to support other internal groups as needed. Exceptional Microsoft Office skills (Excel, Word). They should enjoy problem solving and collaborating in a team environment. What will set you apart Public accounting firm experience / CPA / MBA a plus Experience in commercial real estate, Financial Services, or Asset Management industry. Real Estate industry knowledge of debt/equity terms and financial application Note : Prudential is required by state specific laws to include the salary range for this role when hiring a resident in applicable locations. Agencies decide what gets planned, pitched, and bought. This role exists to make X the default recommendation inside those rooms.

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Why User Behavior?

You will build the backend systems that fundamentally shift how Roblox responds to unsafe behavior - from reactive, stateless punishment to a personalized, adaptive system that reflects who a user actually is.

You will own core backend infrastructure for a new capability at Roblox: a low-latency behavioral data layer, a centralized rules-and-inference engine, and a unified intervention-delivery framework that together let us treat users based on their real risk profile instead of a single point total. This is a rare opportunity to build foundational, high-scale systems that directly shape how Roblox understands and responds to risk across hundreds of millions of users.

You will feel a deep sense of responsibility building systems that directly affect millions of users, especially minors, on one of the world's largest platforms. Your work will reduce harm, improve fairness, and help ensure Roblox remains a place where creativity and community can thrive safely.

You will:

• Build the User Behavior Foundation: Design and operate the low-latency, per-user behavioral data layer that powers real-time safety decisions - aggregating signals like violation history, in-game reports, and behavioral patterns into a single queryable source of truth.
• Own the Consequence Engine: Build and evolve the centralized decision engine that combines deterministic rules with ML risk signals into a single, consistent safety decision the authoritative system every consequence flows through.
• Own the Feature Restriction Platform: Build a unified, backend-driven framework for delivering safety interventions that any product team can plug into, replacing today's fragmented, feature-specific implementations.
• Unify Abuse Reporting: Build the backend that consolidates reporting channels into a single, scalable framework - integrating LLM-based classification, agentic review workflows, and ML models to improve report routing, prioritization, and reporter feedback while meeting global regulatory requirements.
• Design for trust and auditability: Build serving infrastructure that meets a high bar for explainability and fairness, since these systems directly determine consequences for millions of users.
• Ship code, not just designs: Own end-to-end delivery - from system design through migration, testing, and production operation.

You have:

• 5+ years of experience building and operating production backend systems at scale, ideally in Go or a comparable statically-typed backend language.
• Strong experience designing distributed systems: service APIs (RPC/gRPC), data modeling for high-throughput event ingestion, caching, and low-latency read paths.
• Experience building and evolving rules engines, workflow/decision systems, or similarly stateful business-logic services.
• Experience with streaming or batch data pipelines feeding a feature store or similar ingestion layer, and comfort partnering with ML engineers who consume that data.
• Solid production operations fundamentals: monitoring, alerting, oncall, capacity planning, and incident response for systems with real user-facing impact.
• Nice to have: experience in Trust & Safety, fraud, risk, or other adversarial domains; experience with feature stores or ML-serving infrastructure; experience building frontend-agnostic, backend-driven UI frameworks (e.g. server-driven intervention/notification rendering).

You are:

• A Systems Thinker: capable of designing infrastructure that other teams (ML, feature teams, policy) build on top of, not just point solutions.
• A Pragmatic Builder: scrappy and impact-oriented, comfortable turning scattered, undocumented signals and legacy code paths into clean, well-owned services.
• Comfortable with Ambiguity: this space is actively being redefined — you'll help set the standard, not just implement one handed to you.
• A Reliability-Minded Engineer: you treat testing, migrations, and oncall as first-class parts of the job, not afterthoughts.
• Committed to Ethical, Responsible Engineering: dedicated to building systems that are fair, auditable, and operate with the utmost responsibility toward user safety.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Mid-Market Account Executive on Anthropic's High Tech team, you'll drive the adoption of safe, frontier AI by securing strategic deals with tech-forward mid-market companies, unlocking new value streams throughout their business. The role sits at the intersection of consultative selling and technical fluency, helping customers empower their workforce, accelerate processes, and build products with Claude. In collaboration with GTM, Product, Engineering, and cross-functional teams, you'll continuously refine our value proposition, sales methodology, and market positioning to ensure differentiated value across the ecosystem.

You will be contributing to the GTM strategy for our High Tech team, focusing on sector-specific solutions and strategies within key verticals. In addition, the Mid-Market team is pioneering a new scaled sales playbook, where human AEs direct AI Agents to automate key elements of the buyer’s journey, while maintaining human engagement with prospects in the elements of a sales process that can’t be automated.

Responsibilities:

•

Run an end-to-end sales cycle, from first outbound to launch

•

Win new business and expand existing accounts

•

Build and execute sales strategies that drive quota attainment. Identify market opportunities, generate pipeline, and drive revenue

•

Become a trusted advisor to customers, understanding their unique needs and crafting tailored AI solutions

•

Leverage your technical aptitude to earn credibility with engineers, product leaders, and executives

•

Shape product roadmaps by gathering customer feedback and translating market needs into actionable insights for Product and Engineering teams

•

Contribute to the Mid-Market GTM strategy by sharing learnings, refining playbooks, and identifying process improvements that make the team more effective

You may be a good fit if you have:

•

4+ years of enterprise sales experience driving adoption of emerging technologies with a consultative, solutions-oriented sales approach

•

Proven experience exceeding revenue targets in fast-paced organizations by effectively managing an evolving pipeline and sales process

•

Demonstrated ability to navigate dynamic stakeholder ecosystems, building consensus and providing innovative solutions to disparate groups

•

Extensive experience negotiating highly complex, customized commercial agreements with multiple stakeholders

•

Excellent communication skills with the ability to build trust and credibility with C-level executives

•

Experience automating workflows or building automations to handle the repeatable components of a sales process

•

A passion for and/or experience with advanced AI systems. You feel strongly about ensuring frontier AI systems are developed safely

• Location: This role does require being in office 4x a week in one of our hubs

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$290,000—$380,000 USD

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. jobs.description:
If you’re looking to make the best co-op games in the world, you’ve come to the right place. We're proud to have some of the best game makers and collaborators in the industry working with us. What's more, we're a fun bunch of game developers, who love to indulge in our passion for video games together. Our games are not for everyone. Are they for you?

We are looking for a

Senior UI Designer (Contractor)

We are looking for a Senior UI Designer to join the Helldivers 2 team. In this role, you will design, improve, and lead the development of intuitive, accessible, and immersive UI systems, spanning both the heat of combat and the meta game around it, from Galactic War and strategy planning to social and squad systems.

Your work will ensure clarity in and out of chaotic combat scenarios without breaking immersion.

Join us in creating the world's best co-op games!

As a Senior UI Designer, you will:

•

Lead the design of complex, high-impact UI systems such as HUD, inventory management, strategy planning interfaces, or social menus.

•

Drive the UI design workflow from wireframing and prototyping to creating art assets and supporting implementation within our current UI ecosystem.

•

Collaborate closely with other UI and game designers, artists, and engineers to ensure cohesive and functional UI solutions.

•

Ensure UI systems align with the overall creative vision in a live-service game.

•

Optimize UI assets for performance, accessibility, and a seamless user experience.

•

Contribute to UI-related discussions in design meetings and actively influence decision-making.

•

Mentor and exchange knowledge with fellow UI designers.

At Arrowhead, every team member has a meaningful impact on the game and is involved in key decisions.

Who you are:

We're looking for someone who is friendly and collaborative, but also hardworking, efficient, and dedicated to the game development craft! You thrive in a fast-paced environment and take ownership of your work.

•

Senior level experience in a similar role within the games industry, for AA or AAA titles and/or for co-op or live-service games.

•

Proven experience designing and implementing high-quality, intuitive UI systems, end to end, from wireframe to prototype to final art asset.

•

A strong understanding of UX principles and best practices in game UI design.

•

Comfortable working with UI middleware such as Noesis GUI.

•

Familiar with design tools such as Figma, Illustrator, InDesign, or even Photoshop.

•

The ability to work independently, take responsibility, and spot issues before they become problems.

•

Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments (kanban, standups, design reviews).

•

Enjoys mentoring and knowledge-sharing.

•

Strong communication skills with a cooperative attitude.

•

Excellent written and spoken English skills.

Bonus points if you have:

•

Experience with Stingray or a comparable proprietary engine.

•

Console certification experience (PlayStation TRC / platform conventions).

•

Accessibility design experience (colorblind modes, subtitle/HUD scaling, controller remapping).

•

Have worked in a Contractor/Plug & Play model.

How to apply

If you think that this position matches your background and skills, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV in English as soon as possible. We ask that your application always include relevant work samples or a link to your portfolio.

We interview candidates continuously and hire when we find a good fit.

Practical Information

•

Contract type: Fixed-term, 9 months (ideal start: January 2027).

•

Scope: Full-time, 40 hours per week.

•

Location: Stockholm office, hybrid setup possible.

•

Eligibility: You must already have the right to work in Sweden and be based in or near Stockholm. We're not able to offer visa or relocation sponsorship for this role.

We are a pet friendly office! You can expect to find dogs and occasionally some cats around.

What we offer

Arrowhead Game Studios is a growing team of about 140+ people, best known for our co-op titles. Despite our size, we remain a friendly and down to earth bunch, who love to indulge in our passion for video games together.

Located in the heart of Södermalm, in Fatburen in the middle of the Game Dev scene we enjoy everything Stockholm has to offer. The is a a lot of different types of activities immediately available on our doorstep.

Our talented developers are crucial to our success, therefore we put a lot of emphasis in creating and maintaining a prosperous culture. We’re committed to open and transparent communication. Your ideas are welcomed, valued, appreciated - the ceiling for creative discussions is high.

We also have numerous work benefits for all our employees. You can read about them here!
